notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Born to Drive attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
